blocks.section: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries
blocks.content: Total capacity is sum of capacities of all storage batteries when several packs of storage batteries are parallel.

section_path.title: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries

blocks.section: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries
blocks.content: Using  temperature  of  storage  battery  is  0~40 ℃ .  Service  life  of  storage  battery  is  in  inverse proportion  with  temperature  of  storage  battery,  so  it  shall  fully  consider  radiation  when  it  is operated under condition, which is easy to cause high temperature of storage battery, to prevent temperature rise of storage battery (when temperature of storage battery rises, corrosion of polar plate caused by sulfuric acid will be worse so that the service life is shorten). If possible, it shall equip air-conditioning device in UPS room to prolong service life of storage battery.

section_path.title: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries

blocks.section: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries
blocks.content: After finishing installation of power supply system, it must charge the storage battery used for the first time or not used for a long time before usage. Storage battery can loss its capacity during storing due to self-discharging for a long time, and it cannot reach corresponding performance if it is not charged.

section_path.title: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries

blocks.section: 6.5.3 Notice for Usage and Maintenance of Batteries
blocks.content: It shall check and fasten all connecting parts and connecting wires of fasteners for battery pack to prevent accident.
